reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Vandebron again
reauth_confirm.description: Vandebron now requires a browser login (with two-factor authentication). Log in again to keep this integration working.

abort.already_configured: This Vandebron account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different Vandebron account than the one configured.
abort.invalid_auth: Vandebron rejected the login. Try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Vandebron. Check your internet connection.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. Set your external or internal URL in Home Assistant, or enable My Home Assistant.
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining the access token.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timeout while obtaining the access token.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Authorization error while obtaining the access token.
